word_tokenize: tokenize a string into words with character offsets using spaCy English tokenizer
remove_brackets: remove bracket characters from a sentence and return cleaned text with word spans
process_rephrased_csv: load rephrased sentence pairs from CSV files and process bracket annotations
build_rephrase_trees: build rephrased sentence trees by mapping bracket spans onto original valid tree structures
export_rephrase_trees: export processed rephrase trees as a JSON file for downstream use
